source: Authenticated read-only Google Search Console Search Analytics export retained in SUPERDESK_Search_Baselines_2026-11-22.json

scope.position: GSC aggregate average, not a current SERP rank
scope.page_totals: Queried separately across all queries; do not substitute them for exact-query clicks

hypotheses.correction: Withhold unverified nutrition annotations and the associated verified-data claim while preserving the reviewed recipe.
hypotheses.search_hypothesis: Removing demonstrably invalid information may improve trust and useful search engagement; no ranking or traffic lift is established.
hypotheses.primary_search_metric: Absolute page and relevant Mombar query-cluster clicks, interpreted with comparable exposure and country/device mix.
hypotheses.technical_acceptance: No invalid per-100 g values or verified-attribution; ingredient quantities, recipe method, schema and canonical retained.

hypotheses.correction: Align description, Open Graph and Twitter with the existing Madrid-style, four-sandwich, 40-minute recipe.
hypotheses.search_hypothesis: Accurate descriptive metadata may improve qualified search engagement; zero scored-query clicks are the baseline, not an expected lift.
hypotheses.primary_search_metric: Relevant-query and page clicks/CTR with country, device and query-mix context.
hypotheses.technical_acceptance: Exact approved metadata parity, unchanged title/canonical/method, PT40M and four-sandwich structured yield retained.

release.instruction: Before a separately approved release, refresh and freeze final GSC windows, relevant country/device cohorts and before-content evidence; record actual production revision and ship timestamp separately from merge time. Preserve this approval-time record.

review.day14: Directional review using 14 complete post-release days after data settles; compare matching query/country/device scopes and report absolute counts.
review.day28: Review the first complete 28-day post-release window against the immutable ship-time baseline; report clicks, impressions, CTR, position and composition changes.
review.sparse_results: Keep inconclusive if exposure or counts are too small or composition/seasonality confounds comparison. Three to five first relevant clicks is an operational checkpoint, not statistical proof.
review.monetization: No conversion or revenue claim established by these GSC measurements.
